name: gilbert-codex
description: GUI-first local desktop agent workspace built with React, Tauri, and Rust.
author: Gilbert Codex Contributors

scripts.rust:check:dictation: npm run dictation:vulkan-sdk && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/run-native-whisper-command.ps1 cargo check --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --features offline-dictation-gpu
scripts.rust:check:dictation:cpu: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/run-native-whisper-command.ps1 cargo check --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --features offline-dictation
scripts.rust:check:dictation:cuda: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/run-native-whisper-command.ps1 cargo check --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --features offline-dictation-cuda
scripts.rust:check:dictation:gpu: npm run dictation:vulkan-sdk && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/run-native-whisper-command.ps1 cargo check --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --features offline-dictation-gpu
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run rust:fmt:check && npm run rust:check
scripts.app:dev:dictation: npm run dictation:model && npm run dictation:vulkan-sdk && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/run-native-whisper-command.ps1 tauri dev --features offline-dictation-gpu
scripts.app:build:windows: npm run dictation:model && npm run dictation:vulkan-sdk && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/run-native-whisper-command.ps1 tauri build --bundles nsis --features offline-dictation-gpu
scripts.app:build:windows:cpu: npm run dictation:model && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/run-native-whisper-command.ps1 tauri build --bundles nsis --features offline-dictation
scripts.app:build:windows:cuda: npm run dictation:model && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/run-native-whisper-command.ps1 tauri build --bundles nsis --features offline-dictation-cuda
scripts.app:build:windows:gpu: npm run dictation:model && npm run dictation:vulkan-sdk && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/run-native-whisper-command.ps1 tauri build --bundles nsis --features offline-dictation-gpu
scripts.app:installer: npm run installer:assets && npm run dictation:model && npm run dictation:vulkan-sdk && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/run-native-whisper-command.ps1 tauri build --bundles nsis --features offline-dictation-gpu
scripts.app:release:windows: npm run installer:assets && npm run dictation:model && npm run dictation:vulkan-sdk && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/run-native-whisper-command.ps1 tauri build --bundles nsis --config src-tauri/tauri.updater.conf.json --features offline-dictation-gpu
scripts.cloud:9router:build: node scripts/gcloud.mjs builds submit cloud/nine-router-gateway --tag us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/gilbertcodex-40428/gilbert-cloud/gilbert-nine-router-gateway:latest --project gilbertcodex-40428
scripts.cloud:9router:deploy: node scripts/gcloud.mjs run deploy gilbert-nine-router-gateway --image us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/gilbertcodex-40428/gilbert-cloud/gilbert-nine-router-gateway:latest --region us-central1 --project gilbertcodex-40428 --allow-unauthenticated --min-instances=1 --max-instances=1 --concurrency=10 --timeout=3600 --set-env-vars FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID=gilbertcodex-40428,FIREBASE_STORAGE_BUCKET=gilbertcodex-40428.firebasestorage.app,GILBERT_PUBLIC_BASE_URL=https://gilbert-nine-router-gateway-4bwbtno2aq-uc.a.run.app
scripts.cloud:billing:build: node scripts/gcloud.mjs builds submit cloud/billing-gateway --tag us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/gilbertcodex-40428/gilbert-cloud/gilbert-billing-gateway:latest --project gilbertcodex-40428
scripts.cloud:billing:deploy: node scripts/gcloud.mjs run deploy gilbert-billing-gateway --image us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/gilbertcodex-40428/gilbert-cloud/gilbert-billing-gateway:latest --region us-central1 --project gilbertcodex-40428 --allow-unauthenticated --min-instances=1 --max-instances=3 --concurrency=40 --timeout=300 --set-env-vars FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID=gilbertcodex-40428,GILBERT_BILLING_RETURN_URL=https://gilbertcodex.com/billing,STRIPE_PORTAL_CONFIGURATION_ID=bpc_1TbsPyRutIy9oqiFTTjy5eSY --set-secrets STRIPE_SECRET_KEY=gilbert-stripe-secret-key:latest,STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET=gilbert-stripe-webhook-secret:latest
scripts.cloud:connectors:build: node scripts/gcloud.mjs builds submit cloud/connector-gateway --tag us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/gilbertcodex-40428/gilbert-cloud/gilbert-connector-gateway:latest --project gilbertcodex-40428
scripts.cloud:github:deploy: node scripts/gcloud.mjs run deploy gilbert-github-connector --image us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/gilbertcodex-40428/gilbert-cloud/gilbert-connector-gateway:latest --region us-central1 --project gilbertcodex-40428 --allow-unauthenticated --min-instances=0 --max-instances=3 --concurrency=40 --timeout=300 --set-env-vars FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID=gilbertcodex-40428,GILBERT_CONNECTOR_SERVICE=github,GILBERT_PUBLIC_BASE_URL=https://gilbert-github-connector-4bwbtno2aq-uc.a.run.app --set-secrets GITHUB_CLIENT_ID=gilbert-github-oauth-client-id:latest
scripts.cloud:google:deploy: node scripts/gcloud.mjs run deploy gilbert-google-connector --image us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/gilbertcodex-40428/gilbert-cloud/gilbert-connector-gateway:latest --region us-central1 --project gilbertcodex-40428 --allow-unauthenticated --min-instances=0 --max-instances=3 --concurrency=40 --timeout=300 --set-env-vars FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID=gilbertcodex-40428,GILBERT_CONNECTOR_SERVICE=google,GILBERT_PUBLIC_BASE_URL=https://gilbert-google-connector-4bwbtno2aq-uc.a.run.app --set-secrets GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID=gilbert-google-oauth-client-id:latest,GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET=gilbert-google-oauth-client-secret:latest
scripts.cloud:discord:deploy: node scripts/gcloud.mjs run deploy gilbert-discord-connector --image us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/gilbertcodex-40428/gilbert-cloud/gilbert-connector-gateway:latest --region us-central1 --project gilbertcodex-40428 --allow-unauthenticated --min-instances=0 --max-instances=3 --concurrency=40 --timeout=300 --set-env-vars FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID=gilbertcodex-40428,GILBERT_CONNECTOR_SERVICE=discord,GILBERT_PUBLIC_BASE_URL=https://gilbert-discord-connector-4bwbtno2aq-uc.a.run.app --set-secrets DISCORD_CLIENT_ID=gilbert-discord-oauth-client-id:latest,DISCORD_CLIENT_SECRET=gilbert-discord-oauth-client-secret:latest,DISCORD_PUBLIC_KEY=gilbert-discord-public-key:latest,DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN=gilbert-discord-bot-token:latest
